rationale: JD brings deep web3 and developer-tools expertise from his work at 404s and SuperteamDAO, while Allen is exploring the consumer-AI space at Build AI—two adjacent frontiers in emerging tech where cross-pollination often sparks novel ideas. JD's track record blending technical execution (Solidity, smart contracts) with community and content production could offer Allen perspective on how to build community and narrative around AI products, while Allen's exposure to the AI ecosystem may interest JD as web3 and AI convergence becomes increasingly relevant.
intro_message: JD, meet Allen Xu — he's working on consumer AI at Build AI and could offer fresh perspective on where AI and web3 might intersect, and you might have some thoughts on building community around emerging tech.
